reuse.why: Extends the shared visibleUntemplatedCategory SQL fragment, but ignores the existing notes table (notes keyed by group id, already joined elsewhere in actions.ts/statements.ts) and invents a new category_groups.notes column instead.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is written twice in different languages (SQL LIKE in the shared fragment and a JS includes() in copyPreviousMonth), and group notes storage is duplicated with a new column parallel to the notes table.

placement.why: Exclusion sits in budget/actions.ts next to the hidden rule, which is right, but adding a schema column, DB types and API model fields puts notes data in a layer where the tree does not keep notes.

scope.why: Adds a migration, DbCategoryGroup/CategoryGroupEntity fields and an API model change that the request does not need, since group notes already exist in the notes table.

maintainability.why: Two sources of truth for group notes (the UI-edited notes table vs an unused new column) and a rule split between SQL and JS would confuse a maintainer and likely never match what users type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/migrations/1791800000000_add_category_group_notes.sql and actions.ts: reads g.notes from a new column instead of the existing notes table (notes n WHERE n.id = group id).

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts copyPreviousMonth re-expresses the SQL `COALESCE(g.notes,'') NOT LIKE '%#fixed%'` from visibleUntemplatedCategory as `(prevBudget.group_notes ?? '').includes('#fixed')`, alongside the already duplicated hidden checks.

one_place.where: Rule lives in visibleUntemplatedCategory SQL (setZero/average actions) and separately as a JS check in copyPreviousMonth on getBudgetData rows.
